chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Hammad ibn Isa from Imran al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"It is appropriate for the Mutamatti' (pilgrim performing Hajj al-Tamattu') to visit the House (the Kaaba) on the Day of Nahr (10th of Dhu al-Qi'dah) or from its night, and he should not delay that."

key_terms.لِلْمُتَمَتِّعِ: For the Mutamatti' (one who performs Hajj al-Tamattu')
key_terms.مِنْ لَيْلَتِهِ: From its night (the night before the 10th)
key_terms.يَوْمَ اَلنَّحْرِ: The Day of Nahr (10th of Dhu al-Qi'mah)

ai.seo_question: When should a Mutamatti' pilgrim visit the Kaaba during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the urgency of the Mutamatti' pilgrim performing the Tawaf al-Qudum (or first Tawaf) immediately upon reaching the state of Ihram for Hajj, specifically on the Day of Nahr or its preceding night. Scholars highlight this as a key differentiator for Mutamatti' compared to Qarini pilgrims, emphasizing that delaying this ritual act is discouraged to maintain the spiritual momentum of the Hajj rites. The instruction reflects the practical jurisprudence of the Imams regarding the seamless integration of Umrah and Hajj components.
